result: NEAR MISS, not filed. The article says the printing and minting business moves to Printing and Minting Company of Zimbabwe (PMCZ) with the RBZ holding '100 percent equity in the printing and minting business for national security', and that at inception in 1966 Fidelity's business 'was largely to print secure banknotes'. It never says PMCZ prints banknotes. Filing would be inference. A current RBZ or PMCZ statement is still needed. Note the correct name order: Printing and Minting Company of Zimbabwe, not Minting and Printing.
